name: Écarté
summary: A classic two-player trick-taking game with a Piquet pack where players may exchange cards before playing for tricks.
rules_text: Use a 32-card Piquet pack (7,8,9,10,J,Q,K,A with Ace between 10 and Jack, King high). Deal 5 cards each in 2+3 or 3+2 and turn the 11th card for trump. If turned King, dealer scores 1. Elder may propose to discard N cards. Dealer may accept or refuse. If accepted, elder discards N and draws N from stock, then dealer must discard at least 1 and draws same number. Proposals may repeat until elder stops, dealer refuses, or stock empty. If elder makes no proposal or dealer refuses first proposal, that player becomes vulnerable and opponent scores an extra point if he wins majority. Before first trick, holder of trump King may announce it to score 1. Elder leads. Must follow suit if possible, must win trick if possible. Highest of led suit wins unless trumped. Most tricks scores 1, winning all five (vole) scores 2, plus 1 extra for beating vulnerable. First to 5 points wins.
rating_reason: Two-player trick-taking with discard phase, strategic.
